what: A photo inside a 1000px perspective panel floats transparently at z 400px toward the viewer, then once 20% of the panel is visible it recedes into place over 1s cubic-bezier(.36,.01,.29,.99) while appearing. The panel clips overflow, so the photo comes in larger than the panel and then settles into the frame. Scrolling back below the panel (or up) returns it to the front.

options.[data-fx-part=image]: Photo to recede (first child if none)
options.back: If off, it stays as is after entering once
